sloka: ततः शर सहस्राणि निर्ययुः चाप मण्डलात् ।सर्वा दश दिशो बानैः आपूर्यन्त समागतैः ॥३-२५-३८॥
transliteration: tataḥ śara sahasrāṇi niryayuḥ cāpa maṇḍalāt ।sarvā daśa diśo bānaiḥ āpūryanta samāgataiḥ ॥3-25-38॥

translations.english: The demons, though wounded, could not see whereform the terrible arrows came. They only saw Rama shooting the arrows.
